title: Kayak Lake George
specs: Located in a shallow, calm, no-wake zone of Lake George
Lake George is clean, 32 miles long, with unique marine life including fish, mammals, birds, reptiles
Ideal kayaking season late spring to early fall with calm weather and scenic views
No age limit but infants and babies not recommended
Life jackets are required by New York State law and must be worn on the water
No swimming ability required; life jackets keep you afloat
Children under 7 recommended to sit in front of tandem kayak with adult steering
Children over 7 can paddle single kayaks
Child-, youth-, and adult-size life jackets provided

includes: Kayak, life jacket, oar, safety flag
blurb: Guests rent kayaks, paddleboards, or paddle boats to explore Lake George, a calm, shallow, no-wake zone ideal for beginners and families. Life jackets, oars, and safety flags are provided with rentals. The business operates daily from May through mid-October, offering walk-in rentals and expert advice at the north end of Lake George Village.
extraNote: Open daily 9:30 AM to 5 PM; last kayak out at 5 PM, return by 6 PM · No pets allowed due to safety measures · Parking available · Walk-ins welcome · Shore Meadows Lodge, north end of Lake George Village · May through mid-October
